command: set -euo pipefail; export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm use 22 >/dev/null; LOG="$HOME/.claude/star/desktop-commander-remote.log"; PIDF="$HOME/.claude/star/desktop-commander-remote.pid"; mkdir -p "$HOME/.claude/star"; if [ -f "$PIDF" ] && kill -0 "$(cat "$PIDF")" 2>/dev/null; then echo ALREADY_RUNNING_PID=$(cat "$PIDF"); else : > "$LOG"; nohup npx -y @wonderwhy-er/desktop-commander@latest remote >"$LOG" 2>&1 < /dev/null & echo $! > "$PIDF"; echo STARTED_PID=$(cat "$PIDF"); fi; sleep 4; echo NODE=$(node -v); echo PID=$(cat "$PIDF"); echo ALIVE=$(kill -0 "$(cat "$PIDF")" 2>/dev/null && echo yes || echo no); echo '---LOG---'; tail -n 80 "$LOG"
